headline: ماذا حدث حين عرضت مؤسسات صحية على أطبائها أرقام أدائهم؟
reviewer: AI editorial review using the owner's arabic-editorial-reviewer and english-editorial-reviewer agents (not a human reader test)

introduction_answers.problem: قد يعمل الطبيب سنوات دون أن يرى أرقامًا عن عمله.
introduction_answers.who: الأطباء والفرق في المؤسسات الصحية، ومرضاهم.
introduction_answers.change: تقيس مؤسسات صحية أداء أطبائها وتعرض عليهم النتائج؛ وفي مراجعة لتجارب عشوائية زادت الممارسة المطلوبة بنحو 6 نقاط مئوية في المتوسط، مع تفاوت كبير.

summary: عرض أرقام الأداء على الأطباء حسّن ممارستهم قليلًا في المتوسط، وكان الأثر أكبر حين خصّت الأرقام الطبيب نفسه وقدّمها زميل يعرفه ومعها خطة عمل.
terminology_evidence: Audit and feedback, systematic review, randomized trial, percentage point, benchmark and risk of bias are explained at first use or in the glossary; English terms are in parentheses after the Arabic.
language_evidence: Arabic and English reviewed with the owner's arabic-editorial-reviewer and english-editorial-reviewer agents; all BLOCK/FIX findings applied before delivery. Editorial simulation, not a human reader test.

mobile_evidence.scope: Automated rendered-layout verification; screenshots retained for human visual review

source_evidence.claim: 292 randomized trials; 81% physicians; prescribing 47%, test ordering 35%; 177 studies A&F vs control: median absolute improvement 2.7% (IQR 0.0-8.6); meta-analysis mean 6.2% (95% CI 4.1-8.2), moderate certainty; larger effects with lower baseline and more co-interventions; meta-regression features; 113 (39%) high risk of bias; 26 (9%) in LMICs; repeated delivery associated with smaller effect
source_evidence.location: PubMed abstract PMID 42325158 (same results as pub4, PMID 40130784)

source_evidence.claim: 56 RCTs in primary care; antibiotic volume RR 0.89; unnecessary initiation RR 0.77; substantial heterogeneity, non-standard outcome definitions
source_evidence.assessment: Systematic review and meta-analysis (Xu et al., 2025)

source_evidence.claim: Ontario, 833 endoscopists randomized (417/416); polypectomy rate not improved overall (P=0.09); improved among lower performers (P=0.02)

Stepped-wedge randomized trial, 7 pediatric EDs (4 academic, 3 affiliated), 2013-2016; monthly site-level reports with benchmarks to leaders; vitals documentation +10.1%; throughput measures worsened (time to clinician, length of stay, left without being seen); mixed results

201 sites (100 vs 101), 14,915 patients; A&F + peer comparison + education vs audit alone; improved documentation of tumour features and resection completeness; no difference in chemotherapy, detrusor muscle sampling or early recurrence; control arm also improved

decision: CI candidate PASS only; authoritative approval is successful GitHub Actions job
